Task 4. Turn the material below into a project handoff note. Include system goals, architecture, failure modes, and concrete next steps.

Context:

In a cross-layer lookahead design, the runtime may try to use information from one layer to guide scheduling decisions for the next layer. The strongest version would maintain a live pending window in which dispatch and combine flows from multiple stages become ready over time and are jointly scheduled from a single global ready set. However, many existing model runtimes still expose the MoE computation as a sequence of coarse barriers: a dispatch collective, then expert compute, then a combine collective.
